Note from a paediatric registrar
--------------------------------

Reviewing a 6-year-old in clinic. Autism diagnosis age 3, moderate learning difficulty,

Genetics history: an epilepsy gene panel was sent in 2018 and reported as normal. I don't

Consultant is away. What should I be requesting, and is the 2018 panel result something I
